request.title: Navigation assumes all flight paths are unlocked
request.description: The navigation feature built into the addon assumes that the character has all flight paths available. It needs to learn what flight paths the player has learned when visiting a flight master. It should re-learn each time in case new ones are discovered.

criteria: A character's navigation must avoid offering undiscovered flight paths as usable.
A flight-master visit must teach navigation about the paths this character has learned.
A subsequent visit with a newly learned path must refresh what navigation considers available.
